desc:
A KEYBOARD AND MOUSE ARE REQUIRED TO PLAY. PLEASE ENSURE YOU HAVE BOTH BEFORE PURCHASING.

Armo is a tactical first-person shooter inspired by Arma Reforger, built around teamwork, communication, and large-scale military combat. Realistic weapon mechanics, an advanced medical system, and squad coordination make planning and cooperation essential.

Armo is currently in early development and improving. Features may be incomplete, and you may encounter bugs, performance issues, or changes to gameplay as development progresses.

Paid early access is optional and supports development. Armo will become free to play upon its official release. Purchasing early access does not grant exclusive gameplay advantages; it provides access to an unfinished game ahead of release.

Thank you for supporting the development of Armo.
